note: On ZX local (u, v, w) maps to world (v, w, u). origin (1,2,3) is a world point; the local offset (3,-2,5) adds world (-2,5,3), so the plane origin is (-1,7,6). The 3 by 4 right triangle has area 6 and perimeter 12; extrusion by +7 along world +y gives V=42, A=2*6+7*12=96, five planar faces, centroid (-1+10/3, 7+7/2, 6+2).
